title: MOCA EU AI Act Profile Data
description: JSON Schema for the profileData.euAiAct object, per MOCA EU AI Act Profile §3.

riskTier.description: Regulatory risk classification, e.g. prohibited, high_risk, limited, minimal. Open vocabulary — no enforced enum, allowing for regulatory evolution and domain-specific variants.

regulationVersion.description: Version, edition, or regulation ID being applied, e.g. 2024/1689. Allows classifications to remain traceable as regulation is amended.

intendedPurpose.description: Natural-language description of the system's intended purpose and use case.

annexIiiCategory.description: Annex III high-risk category, e.g. Employment decision-making, Biometric identification. Open string; applicable if the package is classified as high-risk.

provenanceUri.description: Reference (URL or URN) to documentation or a knowledge node describing data provenance, collection method, and preprocessing.

dataCutoff.description: Most recent date of data collection or update (ISO-8601), e.g. 2024-06-30.

level.description: Oversight model, e.g. human_in_the_loop (human reviews every decision), human_on_the_loop (human available for monitoring/override), human_in_command (human retains final authority). Open vocabulary; variations allowed.

overrideNode.description: URN reference to a content node documenting the human override or escalation procedure, e.g. urn:node:override-procedure.

requiredRole.description: Role or team responsible for oversight, e.g. compliance-officer, ethics-review-board.
